title: Treaty of Madrid (13 January 1750)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Madrid (13 January 1750)", at revision 1367898537, opens: "The Treaty of Madrid was an agreement concluded between Spain and Portugal on 13 January 1750. In an effort to end decades of conflict in the region of present-day Uruguay, the treaty established detailed territorial boundaries between Portuguese Brazil and the Spanish colonial territories to the south and west. Portugal also recognized Spain's claim to the Philippines while Spain acceded to the westward expansion of Brazil." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1422396, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "signed by Spain and Portugal on 1750, concerning their empires and status of their territories of what is now Brazil". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
